channel.title: Neorgon Engineering Blog
channel.description: Engineering decisions, design patterns, and open-source stories.

item.title: Everything on the page was correct
item.description: Three fixes to the Neorgon hub: search results buried 1747px below the search box, an icon set 2.7x apart in stroke weight, and a badge that ignored its own card. Each decision was right on its own.

item.title: How We Set Up Google Analytics for Privacy-First Tracking
item.description: A complete guide to implementing Google Analytics with Content Security Policy, privacy considerations, and dual tracking with Plausible Analytics

item.title: When Search Breaks: The Physics of Moving Cards on our open-source Hub
item.description: How we fixed a race-condition bug in our search functionality that was causing cards to disappear when clearing the search. Lessons in DOM manipulation and state management

item.title: The Physics Behind Those Floating Category Pills
item.description: Deep dive into Neorgon's physics-simulated search category pills: spring physics, collision detection, and performance optimization

item.title: Why We Built Prefers-Reduced-Motion Into Every Animation
item.description: Motion-heavy UIs look great but can cause real harm. Here's how we built a comprehensive reduced-motion mode into Neorgon's hub and why accessibility-first engineering matters

item.title: Building 31 Tools: A Monorepo Architecture That Actually Works
item.description: How we structured a 31-tool monorepo with zero shared dependencies, modular ES modules, and a template system that makes new tools take 2 hours, not 2 days

item.title: Why We Chose Glassmorphism (And How to Implement It Accessibly)
item.description: Glassmorphism looks cool, but it's tricky to get right. Here's how we implemented it across 31 tools while maintaining color contrast, readability, and reduced-motion support

item.title: From Idea to Tool in 48 Hours: The Neorgon Build Process
item.description: How we ship new tools fast: a repeatable 48-hour process from idea validation to deployment, documentation, and hub registration
